_about: Hand review of every extracted (server, category, rule) group in out/field_groups.csv. Default = accept. Listed groups are rejected (false positive) or remapped (protocol headers to the category they name). Keys are host|rule (rule as in field_groups.csv; '*' = any host).

reject.*|key:fee_discount: user-facing exchange fee rebate, not advertiser payment terms
reject.catalog.carddeals.co|key:disclosure: value is often 'This card is sold directly by CardDeals' (not an ad disclosure); ad disclosure is carried by affiliate_disclosure
reject.wem3.ai|key:disclosure: denies affiliate tracking ('No outbound link here is affiliate-tracked') - reported separately as a contradictory disclosure
reject.wouhr.de|text:label_text: 'anzeige' = watch display type (filter facet), not German 'Anzeige' (ad)
reject.wouhr.de|key:label: filter facet label 'Anzeige' (display), not an ad label
reject.www.gigstamp.co.uk|url:aff@www.eventbrit: event creator's own Eventbrite tag (source: discovery), coded not gigstamp's ad

notes.mcp.adoraads.ai|key:rank_boost: accepted as ad-ranking score: per-item ranking boost on sponsored results within an auction (auction_id, bid_token present); demo tenant, example.com landing pages
notes.moltad.net|key:max_rate_credits: accepted as INFERRED bid: per-brand maximum rate an advertiser pays per event (100 credits = $1), not labelled 'bid'
notes.lmk.today|url:campaign_id: campaign id inside an ad-server redirect path /api/v1/bid/redirect (host r.v2i8b.com)
notes.mcp.nexbid.dev|url:pid@nexbid.dev: product id passed to Nexbid's own click tracker /api/track/click
notes.picoads.xyz|key:bootstrap_token: per-serve signed token returned with sponsored items (publisher attribution)
notes.*|key:score: relevance score; never counted as auction score (x_relevance_score)
